questions.q: If the components of $q$ and $k$ are independent with mean 0 and variance 1, what is $\operatorname{Var}(q \cdot k)$ for $d_k$-dimensional vectors, and why does that motivate dividing by $\sqrt{d_k}$?
options: It is 1, so the scaling is only cosmetic
It is $d_k$; dividing by $\sqrt{d_k}$ brings it back to 1 so softmax doesn't saturate
It is $d_k^2$; dividing by $d_k$ fixes it
It is $\sqrt{d_k}$; dividing by $\sqrt{d_k}$ makes it 0
questions.explain: Each $q_i k_i$ has variance 1 and the $d_k$ terms add up, so the variance is $d_k$. Large logits push softmax to one-hot weights with tiny gradients; $\operatorname{Var}(q\cdot k/\sqrt{d_k}) = 1$ keeps them at unit scale.

questions.q: How does a causal mask stop token $i$ from attending to future tokens $j > i$?
options: It sets those attention weights to 0 after softmax and leaves the rows as they are
It sets those scores to 0 before softmax
It sets those scores to $-\infty$ before softmax, so $e^{-\infty} = 0$ and the remaining weights still sum to 1
It deletes the future tokens from the value matrix $V$
questions.explain: A score of 0 still gets weight $e^0 > 0$. Using $-\infty$ makes the future weights exactly 0 while softmax renormalises over the allowed keys, so each row still sums to 1.

questions.q: You double the context length $n$ of a transformer. Roughly how does the size of each attention score matrix change?
questions.explain: The score matrix is $n \times n$, so it grows as $n^2$: doubling $n$ gives $4\times$. The KV cache, by contrast, grows only linearly in $n$.

questions.q: A head puts weight 0.9 from the token "mat" onto "sat". What is the safest conclusion?
options: The model's output was caused by the word "sat"
In this head and layer, the new representation of "mat" mostly reads the value vector of "sat" — not a full explanation of the model's decision
All other heads must also attend to "sat"
Removing "sat" will change the prediction by exactly 90%
questions.explain: Attention weights show where one head reads information from. Values, $W_O$, residual paths, MLPs and other heads all mix the signal, so attention ≠ explanation.
